What should I expect at my first visit?

A first visit at Smiles Dental takes about an hour. A hygienist takes digital X-rays, cleans your teeth and checks your gums, and then a dentist examines your mouth, explains anything they find, and gives you a written treatment plan with prices before any work begins. New patients should bring a photo ID, their insurance card, and a list of current medications so the team can check for interactions before any procedure.

How often should adults get a dental cleaning?

Most adults should get a professional dental cleaning every six months. Patients with gum disease, diabetes, or a history of frequent cavities may benefit from cleanings every three or four months, and the dentist at Smiles Dental will recommend an interval based on your exam rather than a fixed schedule.
